en.title: Orders
en.subtitle: Upload tracking numbers to Etsy
en.tabs.label: Order status
en.send.hint: Select orders and enter a carrier and tracking number to upload
en.csv.import_errors: {n} rows could not be read (the first is line {line}).
en.csv.import_unknown_carrier: {n} rows name a carrier that is not in Etsy's list.
en.csv.import_not_waiting: {n} orders are not waiting for shipment and were skipped.
en.csv.import_not_waiting_one: 1 order is not waiting for shipment and was skipped.
en.csv.import_empty: No tracking numbers found in the file
en.country.label: Country you ship from
en.carrier.unknown: {name} is not in Etsy's carrier list for {country}
en.carrier.label: Carrier
en.tracking.label: Tracking number: {id}
en.note: Etsy e-mails every buyer. This cannot be undone, so you check everything before it is sent.
en.restricted.text: Etsy does not allow tracking uploads with this API key (in many countries, Türkiye included, since 2024). Enter tracking numbers in Etsy Shop Manager.
en.restricted.csv: You can download the numbers you typed as a CSV.
en.restricted.maybe: Etsy may refuse tracking uploads with newer API keys for shops that ship from Türkiye. If it does, enter the numbers in Etsy Shop Manager; you can download the ones you typed here as a CSV.
en.confirm.title: Upload tracking numbers to Etsy?
en.confirm.msg: Etsy will e-mail {n} buyers. This cannot be undone.
en.confirm.msg_one: Etsy will e-mail 1 buyer. This cannot be undone.
en.confirm.restricted: Last time Etsy refused tracking uploads with this key.
en.done.title: Shipping notice sent to {n} buyers
en.done.partial_msg: Hover the error badge on a row to see why.
en.done.skipped: {n} orders were skipped because they no longer wait for shipment.
en.done.skipped_one: 1 order was skipped because it no longer waits for shipment.
en.notify.restricted: Etsy does not allow tracking uploads with this key
en.notify.failed: {n} tracking numbers could not be sent
en.notify.failed_one: 1 tracking number could not be sent
en.setup.title: Your orders will show up here
en.setup.msg: Connect your Etsy shop: orders waiting to ship and their tracking numbers are handled on this screen.
en.empty.unshipped_msg: New orders appear here once they are paid.
en.empty.search_msg: Try an order number, the buyer's name or a product name.
en.errors.invalid_csv: The CSV needs receipt_id and tracking_code columns.
en.errors.missing_scope: Your Etsy connection has no permission for tracking. Reconnect on the Shop Connection page.
en.errors.not_waiting: This order no longer waits for shipment, so it was not sent.
en.leave.unsaved: Tracking numbers for {n} orders could not be saved. They are lost if you leave this page.
en.leave.unsaved_one: The tracking number for {n} order could not be saved. It is lost if you leave this page.
en.drafts.failed: Could not save the tracking numbers
en.print.missing_tip: {n} item(s) of this order have no design on this computer, so they cannot be printed. Click the product and add the file on the listing's page.
en.print.title: Print file · #{id}
en.print.sub: Each item's file is made from its listing's print file · nothing is sent to Etsy
en.print.lowered: lowered to {dpi} dpi to fit in memory
en.print.none: Nothing to print in this order.
en.print.seam: The pattern's edges do not meet (ratio {a} / {b}): a line shows where it repeats

en.print.problem.unreadable: The print file cannot be read
en.errors.nothing_to_print: No item of this order can be made yet.
en.print.soft: The design is enlarged {x}×: it prints soft at this resolution, get a larger design
en.print.all_tip: Makes the print files of every order waiting to ship (nothing is sent to Etsy)
en.print.all_none: No order is waiting to ship
en.print.all_skipped: {n} orders have no print file on their listing or no readable size: open them one by one
en.notify.print_missing: {n} orders have no print file on their listing: add it on the listing's page
en.print.seam_fixed: The pattern's edges did not meet: made seamless (your design file is unchanged)
en.ship.title: Must ship by {date}: a late shipment lowers the shop's rating
en.partner.title: Production partner
en.partner.none: Connect the company that prints for you and send an order to it in one click.

en.partner.f_url: Address the order is sent to
en.partner.f_url_hint: Must start with https://. The order is sent there as JSON.
en.partner.f_token_kept: Saved: leave empty to keep it
en.partner.f_files: Send the files too (up to 25 MB each; larger ones go by name only)
en.partner.f_cost_hint: To estimate each order's production cost.
en.errors.already_sent: This order was already sent to the partner.
en.errors.partner_unreachable: The partner could not be reached: {message}
en.errors.partner_refused: The partner did not accept the order ({status}).
